svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Wheel: 200 OD, 20 teeth, 20 mm C45 plate. Each tooth rises

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 14 mm along the circle and drops straight back to the root.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bore 40 with a 12 mm keyway; set screw M10 in the hub side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pawl: 16 mm C45 plate, 25 wide at the pivot (40 OD round end),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 8 wide at the tip; 25 mm pivot hole; harden the tip.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pivot: M24 bolt through the pawl, the 40 mm boss and the cheek,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: nyloc nut inside. Pivot 130 behind and 130 above the drum centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spring: stainless return spring from the pawl to a 6 mm hole in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the cheek ear, so the pawl always drops into the teeth.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The pawl lets the drum wind rope in and stops it running back.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the wheel goes on the drum shaft outside the left bearing,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 10 mm clear of it; the pawl lies in the same plane.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: wind by hand; the pawl clicks into every tooth and holds.
